newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AFL AUSTRALIAN RULES - Former brewing head to replace AFL chief Oakley.
newsitem.headline: AFL AUSTRALIAN RULES - Former brewing head to replace AFL chief Oakley.

text.p: The Australian Football League (AFL) on Wednesday confirmed that former South Australian Brewing Company managing director Wayne Jackson would replace Ross Oakley as AFL chief executive.
Jackson has been a member of the AFL commission since last June and will take over from Oakley in the middle of next month, a statement released by the AFL said.
Jackson resigned his position at South Australian Brewing last month.
He played over 150 senior and seconds games for West Torrens in the South Australian Football League between 1956 and 1973.
